basics.name: Ricardo Martins
basics.label: Senior Microsoft Dynamics Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Microsoft Dynamics Software Engineer with over 15 years of experience delivering secure, scalable solutions in Dynamics 365 across on-premises and cloud environments. Expert in C#, JavaScript, jQuery, integrations with legacy systems via REST APIs and OAuth, and AI-assisted development tools including GitHub Copilot, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, and Azure AI Services to accelerate design, coding, refactoring, testing, and continuous delivery. Proven track record aligning with product owners on roadmaps, mentoring teams, leading production issue resolution, and migrating CRM modules while ensuring data security, responsible AI usage, and compliance.

work.name: BlueCX
highlights: Maintained and evolved the Marketing Events module in Dynamics 365, ensuring stability, scalability, and strong alignment with business stakeholders on roadmaps.
Led implementation of Event Marketing in Dynamics 365 using proofs of concept and templates, reducing reported bugs by approximately 95%.
Automated integrations between Dynamics 365 and legacy systems via REST APIs with OAuth authentication on AWS, delivering secure, scalable, and high-performance solutions.
Trained and mentored three backend developers on Microsoft Dynamics best practices, architecture patterns, and AI-assisted development workflows including GitHub Copilot.

Delivered solutions using C#, JavaScript, jQuery, Azure AI Services, Power Platform, Azure Data Factory, and Azure Databricks while participating in Agile/Scrum ceremonies to remove technical impediments.
Migrated the Marketing module to Dynamics 365 Customer Insights – Journeys, ensuring operational continuity, adherence to Microsoft standards, and minimal oversight on complex tasks.
Applied responsible AI practices ensuring secure handling of confidential client data when using Azure OpenAI and Copilot tools for development productivity.

work.name: NTT DATA Europe & Latam
highlights: Led Dynamics 365 implementation projects for large enterprise clients, establishing strong alignment with product owners on roadmaps and estimates.
Developed JavaScript, jQuery customizations for Dynamics 365 and designed integration architecture between Dynamics and legacy systems, prioritizing security, scalability, and reusability.
Implemented AI-assisted tools to recommend lead contact strategies, improving sales processes for IoT 5G systems and reducing operational rework by 35%.
Applied TDD, BDD, and CI/CD practices while actively participating in Scrum rituals and supporting the team in resolving technical impediments.
Conducted technical and functional requirements analysis, data modeling, and documentation validation in collaboration with application architects.
Provided technical leadership during production issues and performed 1:1 mentoring to drive continuous improvement and results-focused delivery.

work.name: Sistema Educacional Brasileiro S.A. (SEB)
work.position: Arquiteto de Soluções Dynamics e Azure
highlights: Reimplemented Microsoft Dynamics, reducing plugin and flow errors while applying standards, proofs of concept, and templates for high-quality software delivery.
Led code reviews, Scrum ceremonies, and performance analysis, supporting project pipeline delivery with minimal oversight.
Built intuitive enrollment sales system integrated with Dynamics via REST APIs, enabling upselling across 18 units and serving 8,000 students without on-site visits.
Negotiated budgets directly with stakeholders and delivered data-driven solutions to optimize sales and service processes.
Created proofs of concept for integrations and presented reports to stakeholders aligned with OKRs.

work.name: Adentis Portugal
work.position: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Specialist and System Architect
highlights: Developed new Dynamics 365 functionalities and supported projects across Portugal, Germany, and Denmark using C#, JavaScript, and jQuery.
Created Computer Vision application for reading physical invoices, integrated with credit risk analysis systems in Dynamics 365, reducing manual processing by 70%.

work.name: Algar Tech
highlights: Revitalized the entire BackOffice using Dynamics 365 by replacing custom entities with native ones, increasing reliability and reducing future improvement costs.

Developed internal RPA tool with C#, .NET Core, and Selenium-based automated testing that handled over 8 million monthly interactions, reducing licensing costs while stabilizing the Bradesco Call Center environment.
Created standard Dynamics customizations for all internal operations, reducing installation time and cost across the organization.
